name: MonarchCircularProgressViewStyle
title: ProgressCircle
summary: A progress ring in Monarch's colours for the standard ProgressView, determinate or indeterminate, with the value in the middle of the large ring.
whenToUse: For progress with a known fraction in a small space: an upload in a row, a quota, a step count on a card.
whenNotToUse: For a short wait of unknown length, use the standard circular ProgressView (the spinner). For progress across the width of a region, use the linear style, monarchLinear.
api: static func monarchCircular(tone: MonarchTone? = nil, size: MonarchCircularProgressSize = .md, showsValue: Bool = false) -> MonarchCircularProgressViewStyle
init(tone: MonarchTone? = nil, size: MonarchCircularProgressSize = .md, showsValue: Bool = false)
enum MonarchCircularProgressSize { case sm, md, lg }

options.name: tone
options.description: The colour of the arc. nil is the accent tone, the same as .accent.

options.name: size
options.description: The diameter: sm 20, md 32, lg 48, xl 72 points, scaled with Dynamic Type.

options.name: showsValue
options.description: Draws the value in the middle of the ring. Only the lg size has room for it.

states.name: determinate
states.description: The arc starts at the top and covers the completed fraction, limited to 0 through 1.

states.name: indeterminate
states.description: A quarter arc turns; it stays still when Reduce Motion is on.

appearance: A muted track with a round-capped arc in the accent colour, or in the solid colour of the tone, in every theme. The value and the label use the default text colour.
platformNotes: The parity map expected this as the circular form of MonarchProgressViewStyle. That type is the linear style and takes no parameters, so the ring is its own style type, MonarchCircularProgressViewStyle, reached with .monarchCircular; the two can be merged later without changing call sites. SwiftUI's own circular style ignores the value on iOS, which is why the ring is drawn here. Sizes are sm, md, lg and xl (20, 32, 48 and 72 points) as the web, which also has xs (16). The accent is the absence of a tone, because MonarchTone has no accent case; the info tone is also accepted. The web formatValue function is covered by ProgressView's currentValueLabel. The label of the ProgressView is drawn after the ring, where the web label is only an accessible name. Android themes the Material 3 CircularProgressIndicator.
accessibility: The ring and the label are one element whose value is the whole percentage in the environment's locale.
The element has the updates-frequently trait.
There is no built-in name: give the ProgressView a label, or accessibilityLabel, that says what is in progress.
The value in the middle of the ring is hidden from VoiceOver, because the element already has it as its value.
The indeterminate arc does not turn when Reduce Motion is on.
The tone is colour only. Say what it means in the label.
The ring, its stroke and the text scale with Dynamic Type.
edgeCases: A value above the total draws a full ring; a not-a-number fraction draws an empty one.
showsValue has no effect on the sm and md sizes, or without a value.
A currentValueLabel given to the ProgressView replaces the percentage in the middle of the ring; it shrinks to half its size before it is cut.
The arc always runs clockwise from the top, also in right-to-left layouts.

examples.title: Determinate
examples.template:
HStack(spacing: 12) {
    ProgressView(value: {{rings.0.value}}, total: 100)
        .progressViewStyle(.monarchCircular(tone: {{rings.0.tone|tone}}, size: {{rings.0.size|case}}, showsValue: {{rings.0.showValue}}))
        .accessibilityLabel({{rings.0.label}})
    ProgressView(value: {{rings.1.value}}, total: 100)
        .progressViewStyle(.monarchCircular(tone: {{rings.1.tone|tone}}, size: {{rings.1.size|case}}, showsValue: {{rings.1.showValue}}))
        .accessibilityLabel({{rings.1.label}})
    ProgressView(value: {{rings.2.value}}, total: 100)
        .progressViewStyle(.monarchCircular(tone: {{rings.2.tone|tone}}, size: {{rings.2.size|case}}, showsValue: {{rings.2.showValue}}))
        .accessibilityLabel({{rings.2.label}})
    ProgressView(value: {{rings.3.value}}, total: 100)
        .progressViewStyle(.monarchCircular(tone: {{rings.3.tone|tone}}, size: {{rings.3.size|case}}, showsValue: {{rings.3.showValue}}))
        .accessibilityLabel({{rings.3.label}})
}
examples.code:
HStack(spacing: 12) {
    ProgressView(value: 25, total: 100)
        .progressViewStyle(.monarchCircular(tone: .accent, size: .sm, showsValue: false))
        .accessibilityLabel("Upload")
    ProgressView(value: 60, total: 100)
        .progressViewStyle(.monarchCircular(tone: .accent, size: .md, showsValue: false))
        .accessibilityLabel("Import")
    ProgressView(value: 72, total: 100)
        .progressViewStyle(.monarchCircular(tone: .accent, size: .lg, showsValue: true))
        .accessibilityLabel("Sync")
    ProgressView(value: 100, total: 100)
        .progressViewStyle(.monarchCircular(tone: .success, size: .xl, showsValue: true))
        .accessibilityLabel("Backup")
}
